application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The information submitted pursuant to Condition 6B does not demonstrate the level of carbon emissions reduction established within the approved Energy Strategy. As such, the submitted details fail to satisfy the requirements of Condition 6B and are contrary to Policy EQ1 (Energy and Carbon Reduction) of the Local Plan and Policy SI2 (Minimising Greenhouse Gas Emissions) of the London Plan.

Reason : 2 - The information submitted pursuant to Condition 7 is insufficient to demonstrate compliance with the requirements of the condition. Accordingly, the requirements of Condition 7 have not been met, and the condition cannot be discharged. The submission is therefore contrary to Policy SI5 (Water Infrastructure) and Policy SI13 (Sustainable Drainage) of the London Plan.
description: Details of condition 6b Energy Strategy, Condition 7 Water efficiency, condition 8 Sustainable Sourcing of Materials  and condition 10 Evidence of drainage submitted pursuant to planning permission 00188/ADJ20/P2 (P/2024/0043)   date 27/02/2024 for Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans) and 6 (Energy) of planning permission 00188/ADJ20/P1 approved 25/10/2022 for the demolition of the existing six garages and the erection of a part single, part two storey detached house
